snippet.title: Capsule Guy - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Capsule Guy is a challenging platforming game where you shoot lasers at things and win sometimes. Made during four months as a capstone project for a year-long independent study in game development.

GET THE GAME ON ITCH: https://onefin.itch.io/capsule-guy
GET THE GAME ON GAMEJOLT: https://1f1n1ty.gamejolt.io/capsule-guy
